title: Critique: an empty higher-order thought makes the theory incoherent

statements.text: If a lone, unconscious higher-order thought with no target at time t suffices for a conscious episode at t, then by the necessary condition that episode must be the object of a simultaneous higher-order thought, and there is none unless the thought is about itself, which turns the view into a same-order theory.

sources.quote: Thus, the sufficient condition and the necessary condition are incompatible in a situation in which there is only one non-self-referential higher order representation.
I described an incoherence in one form of the higher order thought (HOT) theory
